name: Jay morgan BLVD MURANLS
statement:
Jay Morgan | BLVD Murals

I am a professional mural artist and founder of BLVD Murals, an Austin-based studio specializing in large-scale commercial murals, public art, and architectural installations. With over 15 years of experience, I have designed and executed original artwork for residential buildings, commercial developments, hospitality properties, and public spaces throughout the United States. My portfolio includes numerous large-scale installations, demonstrating my ability to create visually compelling artwork while managing the technical and logistical demands of mural production.

I am particularly interested in the NewBo City Market project because of its role as a gathering place for the Cedar Rapids community. My approach would be to create bold, engaging artwork that reflects the character, history, and creative energy of the New Bohemia District. I welcome input from project stakeholders and the community to help inform the artistic direction. My goal is to deliver an original mural that complements the architecture, enhances the visitor experience, and becomes a lasting visual landmark.
